blind_spots.blind_spot: Sustained on-device generative AI inference has no stated power budget for the end-user device that carries it
blind_spots.operator_reality: An E-5 running continuous SLM inference on an EUD or laptop at an austere OCONUS site drains the battery mid-patrol; battery logistics, not model quality, becomes the reason the tool stays in the pouch. Their site brags latency and locality but never states watts, thermal, or duty-cycle on carried hardware.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team pedigree is LLM research and logistics/policy (Army officer, Congress, Amazon/Google) — model builders optimize tokens/sec, not the battery resupply chain of a dismounted unit.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: EdgeRunner runs directly on laptops, mobile devices, vehicles, and edge hardware - with or without connectivity

blind_spots.blind_spot: The product's value proposition assumes user personalization time that operators do not have
blind_spots.operator_reality: A sergeant who got 20 minutes of training will never configure a 'hyper-personalized' assistant; the demo shines because the demo-giver tuned it, and the fielded unit ships generic — same demo-vs-fielded gap Barry's EDP names. No mention anywhere of operator training, CONOPS, or who sustains it in theater.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Free-tier DoW self-serve rollout ('available for DoW users at no cost') is a SaaS adoption motion, not a fielding motion with a training and sustainment tail.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Your personalized, on-device Generative AI assistant for increased productivity and operational effectiveness

blind_spots.blind_spot: They process drone footage and feed situational awareness yet never mention the TAK ecosystem where tactical SA actually lives
blind_spots.operator_reality: If detections and analysis don't land in ATAK on the operator's EUD, they land in a second screen nobody carries; SA products that ignore TAK get demoed at the lab and left at the FOB.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Assistant/chat UX heritage — the interface metaphor is a conversation window, not a CoT plugin feeding the map every operator already runs.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: an edge-based SLM could process satellite images or drone footage on-site, detecting troop movements, vehicles, or other threats in real time

opener_hook: EdgeRunner's June 2026 Navy IL6 ATO solved the accreditation half of fielding; the unsolved half is turning two research-lab CRADAs into funded programs before the $12M Series A clock does.
what_they_do: Air-gapped, on-device small language models and AI agents for military users in disconnected environments.
